note: Mitchell County Conservation Board park on the west edge of Mitchell, on the Cedar River pool above the Mitchell mill dam and its historic, still-operating hydro-electric powerhouse (National Register). Non-designated sites spread over the shaded interior of the park, inside the shoreline park road. Swim beach with dock, boat and canoe ramps (water trail access 263), two shelters, playgrounds; Cedar River Greenbelt trailhead nearby. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 (undated), ~40 non-designated sites, water + 50-amp (added), showers, flush toilets, dump, self-register FCFS, early May-mid Oct. Riverview stands: sites face the pool above the dam (not the tailwater), across the shoreline park road.
flags: WATERFRONT riverview stands. The camping area is the park interior on the pool ABOVE the Mitchell mill dam (the dam and powerhouse are at the park's south tip, ~43.3184,-92.8812). The below-dam rule does not apply: the sites face the impoundment, not the tailwater. Between the sites and the water is the park's shoreline loop road with a narrow lawn strip, docks and the swim beach, so not riverfront; the county's photos show campers on open lawn with the river visible beyond the road. The pool is ~150 m wide.
FEES undated: '$20 / night' with no year on either county page.
PIN OK (park interior, ~30 m from Google's pin). Website confirmed; no phone on the park pages.
FIT: non-designated lawn sites; the county photos show full-size travel trailers and fifth-wheels.
